about: clarify:interview auto-trigger discrimination set. Each query is labeled with whether clarify:interview SHOULD be the invoked skill. Negatives include cross-lens cases that should route to a sibling skill (unknown/metamedium) or to another domain skill entirely — the interview description must repel them. 'core' items are carried from iteration-3 for comparability; 'adversarial' items are iteration-5 boundary probes drawn from the description's own trigger examples.
